case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment's caption.

number_of_accused.correct_value: 11 accused were challaned; 3 appellants before the Supreme Court; 9 convicted at trial
number_of_accused.reason: 3 is the number of appellants before this Court, not the total accused, which was 11.

accused_gender.reason: Accused are male; the judgment refers to A-9 as the 'uncle' of DW-1 and a family man.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.correct_value: A-9 ran a shop at Bhalesur and owned farms in Sundri
accused_occupation.quote: went to the shop run by him at Bhalesur
accused_occupation.reason: The judgment states A-9's shop at Bhalesur and his farms in Sundri, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not explicitly stated, so 'Not stated' holds.

previous_criminal_record.reason: The judgment gives no criminal record for the accused; the history-sheeter claim concerns the deceased.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased Chetram and his son Kapildeo are male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: Upon reaching the house of accused Darasram
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Nothing in the judgment describes the accused's relationship to the victims; 'Stranger' is not supported.

offence_category.reason: Murder (s.302 IPC) is the central offence and is supported.

statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the sections listed in paragraphs 3 and 25.

weapon.correct_value: Country-made bombs, lathis, tabbal and shovels
weapon.reason: Shovels are omitted; the judgment mentions them as weapons used by the accused.

evidence_type.quote: medical and scientific evidence including the post-mortem reports
evidence_type.reason: Medical evidence is supported, but no recovery evidence is mentioned in the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Use of explosives (bombs); multiple injuries to the deceased
aggravating_circumstances.quote: had made preparation by forming an unlawful assembly
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Explosives and injuries are supported; 'premeditation' is only the High Court's quoted observation, not an identified aggravating factor.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted 9 of 11 accused and imposed sentences.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction and sentence affirmed in Criminal Appeal No. 596 of 1992
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court's outcome is stated: it affirmed the conviction and sentence, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.reason: The Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so the convictions stand.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Rioting (s.148), murder (s.302 r/w 149), attempt to murder (s.307 r/w 149) IPC; Explosive Substances Act ss.4/5
offence_finally_established.quote: Sections 148, 302 read with 149, 307 read with 149, Indian Penal Code, 1860
offence_finally_established.reason: Culpable homicide and criminal breach of trust are never mentioned; the judgment lists rioting, murder, attempt to murder and explosives offences.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Rigorous imprisonment, ranging from 3 years to life imprisonment, concurrent
imprisonment_type.quote: rigorous imprisonment for 3 years to life imprisonment
imprisonment_type.reason: The sentence includes life imprisonment and is rigorous, not a single fixed term.

imprisonment_years.quote: rigorous imprisonment for 3 years to life imprisonment
imprisonment_years.reason: 3 years is only the lowest sentence; the judgment also imposes life imprisonment, which is not captured.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts should omit the outcome, e.g. the facts of the attack, the witnesses, the alibi defence and the trial court's conviction of 9 accused
neutral_facts.quote: The Supreme Court upheld the conviction, finding the prosecution's evidence reliable and the accused's alibi unproven.
neutral_facts.reason: The summary states the Supreme Court's outcome, which neutral_facts must not reveal.

offence_severity.reason: Matches the sentence range stated in paragraph 3.

attempt_completion.correct_value: Completed as to murder of Chetram and Kapildeo; attempted as to PW-3 (s.307)
attempt_completion.reason: Murder was completed, but the s.307 charge concerns an attempt on PW-3, so 'Completed' alone is incomplete.

physical_harm.correct_value: Chetram sustained multiple injuries to vital body parts from bombs; Kapildeo died during treatment; PW-3 sustained lacerated wounds
physical_harm.quote: in the course of treatment, he also died
physical_harm.reason: Kapildeo's injuries from the attack are not stated; PW-3's lacerated wounds are omitted.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charges under ss.148, 302 r/w 149, 307 r/w 149 IPC and ss.4/5 Explosive Substances Act
number_of_offences.quote: Sections 148, 302 read with 149, 307 read with 149, Indian Penal Code, 1860
number_of_offences.reason: The value describes the sentence outcome rather than the number or nature of offences charged.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or financial loss is mentioned, so 'Not applicable' is an acceptable equivalent.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: High Court observed preparation and an unlawful assembly; Supreme Court found it was not a case of prior consultation or deliberation
premeditation_planning.quote: Present is not a case of prior consultation; discussion; deliberation or improvements
premeditation_planning.reason: The unlawful assembly finding is the High Court's quoted view; the Supreme Court found no prior deliberation, which the value omits.

motive.reason: No motive for the accused is identified; the alleged deceased-enemies theory is unsubstantiated.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects the headnote's accepted evidence: undisputed deaths, injuries, and coherent eyewitness testimony.

witness_credibility.reason: Matches paragraphs 10, 16, and 21 on the credibility of PW-3, PW-16 and PW-17.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is stated.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated in the judgment.

bail_history.quote: The bail granted by this Court vide order dated 1st October 2012, stands cancelled.
bail_history.reason: Matches paragraph 27 on cancellation of bail and surrender.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date 17.04.1988, trial judgment 11.05.1992, HC 19.10.2010 and SC 10.10.2023 all match.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appearances section on page 3.

investigation_status.reason: FIR registered, challan presented, and trial completed are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.reason: The FIR delay was argued but held not fatal; no irregularity is found.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted and sentenced (Sessions Trial No. 198 of 1988); High Court affirmed; Supreme Court dismissed the appeal
appeal_history.quote: the guilt of the accused and the sentence of imprisonment imposed in Sessions Trial No.198 of 1988
appeal_history.reason: The trial court convicted the accused; it did not affirm a conviction on appeal, so that entry is wrong.

prosecution_argument.reason: Accurately reflects the prosecution's reliance on PW-3, PW-16 and PW-17 and their consistent testimony.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence also argued the witnesses were close relatives or interested, so their testimony could not be relied upon
defence_argument.quote: since most of the witnesses were close relatives or interested witness
defence_argument.reason: The defence's argument that witnesses were relatives or interested is omitted, though the other points are accurate.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Strict scrutiny, preponderance of probability and the prosecution's burden are all supported by paragraphs 19 and 21.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Cases match the citations list; Ram Jag is referred to rather than relied on, which is a minor point.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the sentences awarded are in no manner excessive or disproportionate
sentencing_rationale.reason: Matches paragraph 25 on proportionality and no interference with sentences.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment identifies no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment does not formally list aggravating factors, so 'None' is acceptable.

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellants are directed to surrender forthwith.
other_sentence_order.reason: Matches paragraphs 27 and 28 on bail cancellation, surrender and consequential steps.
